metadata.title: Chakama-Hajong Tribe Demand Justice | चकमा हाजोंग ने दिल्ली में लगाया इंसाफ का नारा
metadata.description: Protesting against the cancellation of Residential Proof Certificates or RPCs to the communities, the All Chakma-Hajong Community-Based Organizations led by the Arunachal Pradesh Chakma Students' Union and Arunachal Pradesh Hajong Students' Union organised a protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi.
